players.product: High-capacitance MLCCs (CGA/C series) for power-delivery decoupling

quarterly_data.quarter: TDK press release: Inductors: TDK expands multilayer inductors for automotive (10-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TDK expanded its MLJ1608-G series of multilayer inductors (1.6 x 0.8 x 0.8 mm) for automotive power-over-coax (PoC) circuits, used mainly in ADAS cameras; mass production of the new parts began in October 2026. The part has an inductance of 1.2 uH (versus 0.56 uH for conventional products), high impedance from 300 MHz to 2 GHz and 1.7 to 2 times the impedance of conventional components in the 100-700 MHz range; AEC-Q200 compliant.
quarterly_data.figure: 1.2 uH; impedance up to 2 GHz; 1.7 to 2 times conventional impedance; mass production from October 2026
